name: Old Pilot Fane
title: The Quay Bench
examine: The oldest eyes on the water. He has outlived three boats, two portreeves, and every argument about the weather.
lines: Swell's wrong for rain. Wrong for calm too. Interesting day coming.
I piloted grain boats when this quay was six planks and an opinion.
Children take to the water or they take to the road. Both come back, mostly.
